citation: Holman and Wiegert 1999, AJ 117, 621, doi:10.1086/300695 (planets in binaries)
note: Empirical expressions for the largest stable orbit round each star and the smallest stable orbit round the pair, roughly linear in mass ratio and eccentricity; valid for eccentricity up to 0.7 to 0.8 and mass ratio 0.1 to 0.9; Abstract supports both the round-one-star and circumbinary limits. Volume and page are confirmed by [De Cesare and Capuzzo-Dolcetta 2021](https://consensus.app/papers/details/w:f8f93771-4c44-4f84-aefc-93cf61259e66/?utm_source=claude_desktop). Limits are for test particles over 10⁴ binary periods.
